how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-ironforge-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8905:obj:0: Acquire 15 ⟦E1⟧ Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8905:details:0: Well met, ⟦1⟧. I've something that might interest you.
rows.quest:8905:details:1: BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.
rows.quest:8905:details:2: BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit ⟦E1⟧ has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
rows.quest:8905:completion:0: Excellent! Let's perform the trade then. It's hard to part with this excellent armor, but I'm afraid I won't be needing it any time soon.
rows.quest:8905:completion:1: BIf you're interested in performing more work for me, I might be willing to give up the rest of the pieces.

rows.quest:8951:obj:0: Return to Deliana in ⟦E2⟧ with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
rows.quest:8951:details:0: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.
rows.quest:8951:details:1: BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.
rows.quest:8951:details:2: BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
rows.quest:8951:completion:0: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
rows.quest:8951:completion:1: BWell, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.

rows.quest:8977:obj:0: Bring the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to Deliana in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8977:details:0: It's been great working with you, ⟦14⟧. Here is the finished product.
rows.quest:8977:details:1: BI hope it helps you in your current endeavors. And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word. I wouldn't mind having more customers!
rows.quest:8977:completion:0: Excellent! You've done well, ⟦15⟧. I'm not sure I trust the goblin's craftsmanship, but I'm left with no other choice.
rows.quest:8997:obj:0: Speak with Deliana at The High Seat in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8997:details:0: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.
rows.quest:8997:details:1: BGo, before I start to cry. Go back to Deliana in ⟦E2⟧ and tell her what's happened.
rows.quest:8997:completion:0: I am very happy to see you return to me safely, ⟦16⟧. You look well, if not a bit worse for the wear.
rows.quest:8997:completion:1: BCome, tell me of all that has transpired.
rows.quest:8999:obj:0: Give Deliana your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
rows.quest:8999:details:0: That's an amazing story, ⟦17⟧! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.
rows.quest:8999:details:1: BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
rows.quest:8999:completion:0: I'm going to miss you, ⟦18⟧. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.
rows.quest:8999:completion:1: BI hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.
